scope: Static text/JSON contracts and a synthetic loopback HTTP fixture, NOT YAML parse, Docker build, real API, backup, staging or deployment.

results.name: Production and staging gates deny current repository state
Gate requires boolean approvals and immutable digest
New local secret generation is independent and does not write files in tests
Compose source has private DB persistence and loopback-only web publishing
Release Docker build defaults to hashed lock and nonroot; dictionary packaged
Proxy source includes same-origin API and restrictive headers
PWA manifest is valid JSON with existing local icon and login entry
Workflows are read-only and contain no registry push or cloud deploy command
Backup source encrypts and restore refuses non-empty targets without cleaning
Smoke helper accepts loopback fixture and rejects remote targets and readiness 503
